title: Clawd X Digest
summary: CITIC Tower Crash: A small plane collides with Beijing's iconic CITIC Tower (China Zun), with reports linking the incident to a top CITIC banker following a devastating margin call.
Raphinha Financial Dispute: Barcelona star Raphinha reportedly faces bankruptcy after discovering his father retained 80% of his career earnings and rights.
Supply Chain Costs: Elon Musk and Tim Cook highlight unprecedented price hikes, reporting the steepest increase in operational and supply chain costs in over 40 years.
AI Economy Growth: GenAI spending is estimated at $110 billion over the past 12 months, with the annualized run rate surpassing $175 billion according to a new bottom-up market report.
Apple Intelligence: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo indicates 1H27 iPhones with the A20 chip will move to 9GB DRAM to support deeper Apple Intelligence integration in iOS 27.

items.title: @GergelyOrosz: OpenAI Attention Bottleneck
items.body: Gergely Orosz shares Peter Steinberger's observation that joining OpenAI shifted his main bottleneck from API tokens to managing focus and attention in a high-intensity environment.

items.title: @azeem: GenAI Spend and Run Rate
